Smile makeovers

A considered plan, shaped around your smile.

Ask about this treatment

Understanding your options

A smile consultation brings your priorities and oral health together. Depending on your needs, a plan may involve whitening, alignment or restorative treatment. Your dentist will explain alternatives, maintenance and the implications of each option.

What to expect

  1. Discuss what you would like to change.
  2. Assess your oral health and compare suitable options.
  3. Agree a staged plan and written estimate before treatment.

A common question

Do I have to choose veneers?

No. A consultation should explore suitable alternatives. Ask which options preserve tooth structure and what long-term maintenance they need.

Your consultation is the place to discuss suitability, benefits, risks, alternatives and costs for your individual care.
